author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
created_at_checkpoint: non-study smoke run (seed 999) step 3100, before registration
purpose: Explain WHY a pooled persistent edit of the declared mass block fails while the block is causally sufficient: decompose editability into pooled-affine, per-route-affine and copy-target-mean components.
hypothesis: H1 route-specific (non-additive) mass code: per-route affine edits succeed where pooled fails. H2 curved code within a route: per-route affine fails but copying the route-specific target class mean succeeds. H3 block not sufficient alone: copy fails. H4 (added in v2 after v1 returned 'undetermined' on the smoke run): the block is sufficient but each class occupies an extended region whose MEAN is off the code manifold; only copying a real exemplar works.

input_schema.args.canonical_style_only: bool: fit/exemplar pool restricted to digit numbers + full unit names

read_scope: model copies (safetensors); training-pool force examples (ctx.observe.fit_pool) for fitting; development force examples of pretraining families for scoring; never sealed
measurement_definitions: intended = share of eligible examples (answers for edited mass, edited acceleration and unedited all distinct) whose prediction equals the answer computed with the edited mass; edits act on h[0:16] only, routes are (mass unit) x (phrasing family) cells; affine maps are least-squares fits on training-pool examples
changelog: v1: pooled / per-route / copy-mean (controls: additive, route-rotated, scrambled, random)
v2: added exemplar copy and the H4 ring gold case after v1 returned 'undetermined' at smoke steps 2600-3100 (copy-mean 0.44-0.48 while block IIA 1.00)
v3: optional canonical_style_only after T002 showed non-canonical-style sources swap at 0.14 vs 1.00 (the v2 'undetermined' verdicts were contaminated by unseen surface forms)
